name: dsh-research
description: Research: a run is a folder with RUN.json and a passport.json that records what the human decided in their own words. Nine rs_* tools (open, new, plan, read, write, cite, verify, review, build) over an append-only claim and source ledger, a document dialect where every claim is a span the ledger tracks and every number a claim rests on is a validated statistic rather than prose, a structured method record (databases, date of access, search string, criteria, PRISMA-shaped screening counts) that r0 validates and the build prints as the document's own flow, a disclosure record (authors with CRediT roles, ethics approval that must name the body and the reference, consent, funding, conflicts, data availability and AI use) that the submission folder prints as a disclosure artifact and the anonymized manuscript never carries, six citation styles, a dependency-free Markdown/DOCX builder, a judge calibration set whose FNR and FPR are reported against stated bars, two frame gates plus a build gate answered by a person in the right bar rather than by the model, eight bundled skills, and the Research tab that shows a run while it is being worked on. Host half plus UI, no vendored engine, no npm dependency, and no socket of its own.
